# Tapir commands: Analytical Commands

The 35 commands of this group, with their parameters, results and examples. Every group and how a command is sent: [commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md).

## Analytical Commands

### GetCurrentAnalyticalModel

Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model created for the current view. Available from Archicad 27.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetCurrentAnalyticalModel

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view.

Grasshopper: `GetCurrentAnalyticalModelComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetCurrentAnalyticalModel.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetCurrentAnalyticalModel.py): Prints the id of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view with GetCurrentAnalyticalModel. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

### UpdateAnalyticalModel

Triggers an update of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given. Available from Archicad 27.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#UpdateAnalyticalModel

Parameters:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model to update. The model of the current view is updated when it is omitted.


Grasshopper: `UpdateAnalyticalModelComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/UpdateAnalyticalModel.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/UpdateAnalyticalModel.py): Updates the Structural Analytical Model of the current view with UpdateAnalyticalModel. Leave out 'analyticalModelId' to update the model of the current view. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

### SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule

Sets the generation settings of the current Structural Analytical Model to no rules. Available from Archicad 27.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule

Parameters: none.


Grasshopper: `SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRuleComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule.py): Sets the generation settings of the current Structural Analytical Model to no rules with SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule. Changes the project's analytical model generation settings and does not restore them. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

### GetAnalyticalModelVariation

Retrieves the variation of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given (the model is required before Archicad 27). The fields of the variation depend on the Archicad version.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalModelVariation

Parameters:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.

Returns:

- `variation` (AnalyticalModelVariation, required)

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalModelVariationComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalModelVariation.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalModelVariation.py): Prints the variation of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view with GetAnalyticalModelVariation. Without 'analyticalModelId' the model of the current view is used, from Archicad 27; before that pass the model.

Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model of the given variation, as returned by GetAnalyticalModelVariation.

Parameters:

- `variation` (AnalyticalModelVariation, required)

Returns:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model of the variation.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalModelComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalModel.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalModel.py): Gets the Structural Analytical Model of the variation of the current view with GetAnalyticalModel. Reading the variation of the current view requires Archicad 27 or later.

### GetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings

Retrieves the visibility settings of the Structural Analytical Model. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings

Parameters: none.

- `visibilitySettings` (AnalyticalVisibilitySettings, required): The Structural Analytical Model visibility settings, with every field.

Requires Archicad 26 or later.

### SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings

Changes the given fields of the Structural Analytical Model visibility settings; the others keep their value. The settings are read back, and a given field Archicad did not keep is reported as an error with the value it kept. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings

Parameters:

- `visibilitySettings` (AnalyticalVisibilitySettings, required): The fields to change. The fields left out keep their current value.


Grasshopper: `SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettingsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings.py): Toggles whether the nodes of the Structural Analytical Model are shown with SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings. Only the given fields change. Reads the setting back and restores it. Requires Archicad 26 or later.

### GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElements

Retrieves the analytical member type (Beam, Column, Roof, Slab, Wall or Unknown) of the given elements from the Complementary Project, the structural analysis project exchanged with Archicad. Without a Complementary Project every element reads Unknown. An element that does not exist gets an error item.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElements

Parameters:

- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `memberTypesOfElements` (array of object or ErrorItem, required): The analytical member type of each element, in the order of the input, as the Complementary Project (the structural analysis project exchanged with Archicad) gives it: Unknown for every element when the project has none. An element that does not exist, or whose type cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElements.py): Prints the analytical member type of the first walls, beams and columns of the project with GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElements. Needs at least one wall, beam or column.

### GetAnalyticalLoadGroups

Retrieves the structural analysis load groups of the project, or the ones given by their ids, with all their fields.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalLoadGroups

Parameters:

- `loadGroupIds` (array of AnalyticalLoadGroupIdArrayItem): The load groups to read, answered in this order, an error object for one that does not exist. Every load group of the project is listed when it is omitted.

Returns:

- `loadGroups` (array of AnalyticalLoadGroup or ErrorItem, required): The load groups of the project, or the ones given in loadGroupIds. A load group that cannot be read is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalLoadGroupsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalLoadGroups.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalLoadGroups.py): Prints the structural analysis load groups of the project with GetAnalyticalLoadGroups.

### GetAnalyticalLoadCases

Retrieves the structural analysis load cases of the given load group, or of the project when no load group is given, with all their fields.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalLoadCases

Parameters:

- `loadGroupId` (GuidId): The identifier of the load group to list the load cases of. Every load case of the project is listed when it is omitted.

Returns:

- `loadCases` (array of AnalyticalLoadCase or ErrorItem, required): The load cases. A load case that cannot be read is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalLoadCasesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalLoadCases.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalLoadCases.py): Prints the structural analysis load cases of the first load group of the project with GetAnalyticalLoadCases. Leave out 'loadGroupId' to get every load case of the project. Needs at least one load group.

Every run adds two new load groups.

### GetAnalyticalMembers

Lists the elements of the curve and surface members of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given (the model is required before Archicad 27).

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalMembers

Parameters:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.

Returns:

- `curveMembers` (Elements, required): The elements of the curve members (beams, columns) of the model.
- `surfaceMembers` (Elements, required): The elements of the surface members (walls, slabs, roofs) of the model.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalMembersComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalMembers.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalMembers.py): Lists the elements of the curve and surface members of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view with GetAnalyticalMembers. Without 'analyticalModelId' the model of the current view is used, from Archicad 27; before that pass the model.

### GetAnalyticalMemberDetails

Retrieves the curve, surface or segmented surface member of the given elements in a Structural Analytical Model, with their connections. Cross sections, curves, nodes and surfaces are returned with every field the Archicad version has.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalMemberDetails

Parameters:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.
- `elements` (Elements, required)
- `segmentationCentralAngle` (number): When given, surface members are read as segmented surface members (for curved walls), each segment spanning at most this central angle, in radians.

Returns:

- `analyticalMembers` (array of AnalyticalCurveMemberDetails or AnalyticalSurfaceMemberDetails or AnalyticalSegmentedSurfaceMemberDetails or ErrorItem, required): The analytical member of each element, in the order of the input. An element that is no member of the model, or whose member cannot be read, is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalMemberDetailsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalMemberDetails.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalMemberDetails.py): Prints the first curve and surface member of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view with GetAnalyticalMemberDetails. Needs at least one analytical member. Reading the members of the current view requires Archicad 27 or later.

### SetAnalyticalReleases

Replaces the releases of the given analytical members, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetAnalyticalReleases

Parameters:

- `releases` (array of ElementAnalyticalRelease, required): The element and its new release, as GetAnalyticalReleases returns it. The release replaces the element's release as a whole.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `SetAnalyticalReleasesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/SetAnalyticalReleases.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/SetAnalyticalReleases.py): Adds a hinge (free rotation around the local y axis) at the end of the first curve member with SetAnalyticalReleases. Needs at least one curve member. Reads the release back and restores the old one. Requires Archicad 27 or later (the command itself works from Archicad 26).

### GetAnalyticalMemberPartGeometries

Retrieves the node of the given analytical member vertices and the curve of the given member edges. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalMemberPartGeometries

Parameters:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.
- `memberPartRefs` (array of AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required): The member parts to get the geometry of: vertices (BegVertex, EndVertex, CustomVertex) give a node, edges (Edge, RatioEdge, CustomEdge) a curve.

- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `supports` (array of AnalyticalSupportDetails or ErrorItem, required): The support and its geometry for each element, in the order of the input. An element that is not an analytical support, or whose support cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalSupportsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalSupports.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalSupports.py): Places a pinned support at the start of the first curve member and prints it with GetAnalyticalSupports. Needs at least one analytical curve member. Deletes the support at the end. Requires Archicad 27 or later (the command itself works from Archicad 26).

### GetAnalyticalLinks

Retrieves the settings, the connected member parts and the geometry of the given analytical links. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalLinks

Parameters:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model the geometry is read from. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.
- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `links` (array of AnalyticalLinkDetails or ErrorItem, required): The link and its geometry for each element, in the order of the input. An element that is not an analytical link, or whose link cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalLinksComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalLinks.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalLinks.py): Links the first two curve members with a rigid link and prints it with GetAnalyticalLinks. Needs at least two analytical curve members. Deletes the link at the end. Requires Archicad 27 or later (the command itself works from Archicad 26).

### CreateAnalyticalSupports

Creates analytical supports from their settings and supported member part, as GetAnalyticalSupports returns them, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateAnalyticalSupports

Parameters:

- `supports` (array of AnalyticalSupport, required): The supports to create, as GetAnalyticalSupports returns them. Each is created from the defaults of the Analytical Support tool.

Returns:

- `elements` (ElementIdsOrErrors, required)

Grasshopper: `CreateAnalyticalSupportsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/CreateAnalyticalSupports.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/CreateAnalyticalSupports.py): Places a fixed point support at the start of the first curve member with CreateAnalyticalSupports. Needs at least one analytical curve member. Requires Archicad 27 or later (the command itself works from Archicad 26).

### CreateAnalyticalLinks

Creates analytical links from their settings and connected member parts, as GetAnalyticalLinks returns them, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateAnalyticalLinks

Parameters:

- `links` (array of AnalyticalLink, required): The links to create, as GetAnalyticalLinks returns them. Each is created from the defaults of the Analytical Link tool.

Returns:

- `elements` (ElementIdsOrErrors, required)

Grasshopper: `CreateAnalyticalLinksComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/CreateAnalyticalLinks.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/CreateAnalyticalLinks.py): Connects the end of the first curve member to the start of the second one with a rigid link using CreateAnalyticalLinks. Needs at least two analytical curve members. Requires Archicad 27 or later (the command itself works from Archicad 26).

### ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortest

Converts the given shortest analytical links (associative to a curve member or a surface member edge) to links connected to a fixed coordinate, in one undo step, and returns the converted links. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortest

Parameters:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.
- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `links` (array of object or ErrorItem, required): The link the API returns for each element after the conversion, in the order of the input. An element that cannot be converted is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortestComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortest.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortest.py): Converts a shortest link to the axis of a curve member into a link to a fixed point with ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortest. Needs at least two analytical curve members. Creates the shortest link from the end of the first member to the axis (edge) of the second one, then converts it; the converted link stays in the project. Requires Archicad 27 or later (the command itself works from Archicad 26).

### GetAnalyticalLoads

Retrieves the settings, the loaded member part, the custom data (the curve of an edge load, the contour of a surface load) and the geometry of the given analytical point, edge and surface loads. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAnalyticalLoads

Parameters:

- `analyticalModelId` (GuidId): The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model the geometry is read from. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.
- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `loads` (array of AnalyticalPointLoadDetails or AnalyticalEdgeLoadDetails or AnalyticalSurfaceLoadDetails or ErrorItem, required): The load of each element, in the order of the input, with its geometry in the Structural Analytical Model and, for an edge or a surface load, its custom data (the curve or contour stored with the element). An element that is not an analytical point, edge or surface load, or whose load cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetAnalyticalLoadsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalLoads.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/GetAnalyticalLoads.py): Puts a 10 kN point load on the start of the first curve member and prints it with GetAnalyticalLoads. Needs at least one analytical curve member and one load case. Deletes the load at the end. Requires Archicad 27 or later (the command itself works from Archicad 26).

### CreateAnalyticalLoads

Creates analytical point, edge and surface loads from their settings, loaded member part and custom data, as GetAnalyticalLoads returns them, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 26.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateAnalyticalLoads

Parameters:

- `loads` (array of object or object or object, required): The loads to create, as GetAnalyticalLoads returns them without their geometry. Each is created from the defaults of its tool. An edge load needs the curve and a surface load the contour it is applied on, in customData.

Returns:

- `elements` (ElementIdsOrErrors, required)

Grasshopper: `CreateAnalyticalLoadsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/CreateAnalyticalLoads.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/CreateAnalyticalLoads.py): Puts a 10 kN point load and a 5 kN/m line load on the first curve member with CreateAnalyticalLoads. Needs at least one analytical curve member and one load case; the loads go into the first load case. Forces are in newtons, downward along the global z axis. Requires Archicad 27 or later (the command itself works from Archicad 26).

### CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembers

Creates elements (beams, columns, walls, slabs, roofs) from the given curve, surface or segmented surface members, in the form GetAnalyticalMemberDetails returns them, optionally with the settings of a favorite, in one undo step. Returns the new elements and, from Archicad 26, the mapping of their edges and vertices to member parts.

Group: Analytical Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembers

Parameters:

- `members` (array of ElementFromAnalyticalMemberData, required): The analytical members to create elements from, in the form GetAnalyticalMemberDetails returns them, so a member read there can be passed on as it is. The elemGuid of a member is ignored. A curve member needs analyticalMemberType and curve, a surface member (or segment) analyticalMemberType and contour; the other fields are zero when left out.

Returns:

- `elements` (array of ElementFromAnalyticalMember or ErrorItem, required): The new element of each member, in the order of the input. A member no element could be created from is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembersComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembers.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Analytical/CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembers.py): Creates a copy of the first curve member's element from its analytical member with CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembers. Needs at least one analytical curve member; the member is passed on as GetAnalyticalMemberDetails returns it, so the new beam or column lies on top of the original. Reading the members of the current view requires Archicad 27 or later.

## Shared schema definitions

Types that parameters and results refer to by name.

### Elements

array of ElementIdArrayItem: A list of elements.

### ElementIdArrayItem

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)

### ElementIdOrError

ElementIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: An element identifier or an error.

### ElementIdsOrErrors

array of ElementIdOrError: A list of element identifiers or errors.

### ElementId

object: The identifier of an element.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### GuidId

object: Identifier.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### Guid

string: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

### Coordinate3D

object: 3D coordinate.
- `x` (number, required): X value of the coordinate.
- `y` (number, required): Y value of the coordinate.
- `z` (number, required): Z value of the coordinate.

### Error

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### ErrorItem

object
- `error` (Error, required)

### SuccessfulExecutionResult

object: The result of a successful execution.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

### FailedExecutionResult

object: The result of a failed execution.
- `success` (boolean (false), required)
- `error` (Error, required)

### ExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of the execution.

### ExecutionResults

array of ExecutionResult: A list of execution results.

### AnalyticalLoadGroupData

object
- `name` (string, required)
- `groupType` (AnalyticalLoadGroupType, required)
- `relation` (AnalyticalLoadGroupRelation, required)
- `loadType` (string): The load type of the group as free text. Empty when it is omitted.

### AnalyticalLoadGroupIdArrayItem

object
- `loadGroupId` (GuidId, required)

### AnalyticalLoadCaseData

object
- `name` (string, required)
- `description` (string): Empty when it is omitted.
- `actionType` (AnalyticalLoadCaseActionType, required)
- `loadGroupId` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the load group the load case belongs to.
- `loadType` (AnalyticalLoadCaseLoadType, required)
- `duration` (AnalyticalLoadCaseDuration)

### AnalyticalLoadCaseIdArrayItem

object
- `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required)

### AnalyticalLoadCombinationData

object
- `name` (string, required)
- `description` (string): Empty when it is omitted.
- `category` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationCategory, required)
- `nationalStandard` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationNationalStandard)
- `type` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationType)
- `loadFactors` (array of AnalyticalLoadFactor): The load cases of the combination with their factors.

### AnalyticalLoadCombinationIdArrayItem

object
- `loadCombinationId` (GuidId, required)

### AnalyticalSegmentedSurfaceMemberDetails

object
- `segmentedSurfaceMembers` (array of AnalyticalSurfaceMember, required): The segments of the surface member.
- `idMapping` (AnalyticalExportIdMapping)
- `connections` (AnalyticalMemberConnections, required)

### AnalyticalSurfaceMemberDetails

object
- `surfaceMember` (AnalyticalSurfaceMember, required)
- `idMapping` (AnalyticalExportIdMapping)
- `connections` (AnalyticalMemberConnections, required)

### AnalyticalCurveMemberDetails

object
- `curveMember` (AnalyticalCurveMember, required)
- `connections` (AnalyticalMemberConnections, required)

### ElementAnalyticalRelease

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)
- `release` (AnalyticalRelease, required)

### AnalyticalCurveMemberStretch

object
- `begAdditionalLength` (number, required): The length added to the curve member at its start.
- `endAdditionalLength` (number, required): The length added to the curve member at its end.

### AnalyticalCurveMemberStretchUpdate

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)
- `begAdditionalLength` (number, required): The length added to the curve member at its start.
- `endAdditionalLength` (number, required): The length added to the curve member at its end.

### AnalyticalMemberCoordinateSystemRequest

object
- `memberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)
- `intersectingMemberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef): When given, the local coordinate system of memberPartRef in its intersection with this member part is returned.

### AnalyticalSupportDetails

object
- `support` (AnalyticalSupport, required)
- `geometry` (AnalyticalSupportGeometry, required)

### AnalyticalLinkDetails

object
- `link` (AnalyticalLink, required)
- `geometry` (AnalyticalLinkGeometry, required)

### AnalyticalSurfaceLoadDetails

object
- `surfaceLoad` (AnalyticalSurfaceLoad, required)
- `customData` (AnalyticalSurfaceLoadCustomData, required)
- `geometry` (AnalyticalSurfaceLoadCustomData, required)

### AnalyticalEdgeLoadDetails

object
- `edgeLoad` (AnalyticalEdgeLoad, required)
- `customData` (AnalyticalEdgeLoadCustomData, required)
- `geometry` (AnalyticalEdgeLoadCustomData, required)

### AnalyticalPointLoadDetails

object
- `pointLoad` (AnalyticalPointLoad, required)
- `geometry` (object, required)
  - `coordinate` (Coordinate3D, required)

### ElementFromAnalyticalMemberData

any or any or any
- `curveMember` (AnalyticalCurveMember): A curve member, creating a beam or a column.
- `surfaceMember` (AnalyticalSurfaceMember): A surface member, creating a wall, a slab or a roof.
- `segmentedSurfaceMembers` (array of AnalyticalSurfaceMember): The segments of a segmented surface member (a curved wall), creating one element.
- `favoriteName` (string): The name of the favorite whose settings the new element gets.

### ElementFromAnalyticalMember

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)
- `idMapping` (AnalyticalImportIdMapping)

### AnalyticalModelVariation

object: The variation a Structural Analytical Model is generated for. Its fields depend on the Archicad version: amVariationGuid from Archicad 27, renovationFilterGuid and layerConnectionClassIds before.
- `amVariationGuid` (GuidId): The identifier of the analytical model variation. Archicad 27 and newer.
- `renovationFilterGuid` (GuidId): The identifier of the renovation filter of the variation. Archicad 25 and 26.
- `layerConnectionClassIds` (array of integer or object): The connection classes of the layers. Archicad 25: a list of integers. Archicad 26: one object per layer, with the layer's attribute index and its connection class.

### AnalyticalMemberType

string ("Unknown", "Beam", "Column", "Roof", "Slab", "Wall"): The analytical member type of an element.

### AnalyticalVisibilitySettings

object: The visibility settings of the Structural Analytical Model. Archicad 26 and newer.
- `visibilityMode` (string ("AnalyticalModelOnly", "AnalyticalModelWithinEntireModel")): Whether only the analytical model is shown or the analytical model within the entire model.
- `isAnalyticalModelVisible` (boolean)
- `areMembersTransparent` (boolean)
- `areSymbolsTransparent` (boolean)
- `areNodesVisible` (boolean)
- `areReleasesVisible` (boolean)
- `areCrossSectionsVisible` (boolean)
- `areCoordinationProfilesVisible` (boolean)
- `areLocalCoordSystemsVisible` (boolean)
- `loadVisibilityMode` (string ("FilterByActive", "HideAll", "ShowAll")): Which loads are shown: filtered by the active settings, none or all.

### AnalyticalLoadGroupType

string ("PermanentLoad", "VariableLoad", "AccidentalLoad", "SeismicLoad", "MovingLoad", "TensioningLoad", "FireLoad"): The type of a structural analysis load group.

### AnalyticalLoadGroupRelation

string ("ExclusiveRelation", "StandardRelation", "TogetherRelation"): How the load cases of a structural analysis load group are combined.

### AnalyticalLoadCaseActionType

string ("PermanentAction", "VariableAction", "AccidentalAction"): The action type of a structural analysis load case.

### AnalyticalLoadCaseLoadType

string ("SelfWeightLoad", "PrestressLoad", "DynamicLoad", "StaticLoad", "TemperatureLoad", "WindLoad", "SnowLoad", "MaintenanceLoad", "FireLoad", "MovingLoad", "SeismicLoad", "StandardLoad", ...): The load type of a structural analysis load case.

### AnalyticalLoadCaseDuration

string ("LongDuration", "MediumDuration", "ShortDuration", "InstantaneousDuration"): The duration of a structural analysis load case.

### AnalyticalLoadCombinationCategory

string ("ULS", "SLS", "ALS", "ANS", "NotDefined"): The category of a structural analysis load combination.

### AnalyticalLoadCombinationNationalStandard

string ("ENULSSTRGEOSetB", "ENULSSTRGEOSetC", "ENAccidental1", "ENAccidental2", "ENSeismic", "ENSLSCharacteristic", "ENSLSFrequent", "ENSLSQuasipermanent", "IBCLRFDultimate", "IBCASDultimate", "IBCASDserviceability", "IBCASDseismic", ...): The national standard of a structural analysis load combination.

### AnalyticalLoadCombinationType

string ("Envelope", "Linear", "Nonlinear"): The type of a structural analysis load combination. Archicad 27 and newer.

### AnalyticalLoadFactor

object: A load case of a structural analysis load combination with its factors.
- `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the load case.
- `factor` (number): The factor of the load case. Left out when it is not set.
- `multiplier` (number, required): The multiplier of the load case.

### AnalyticalLoadGroup

object: A structural analysis load group.
- `loadGroupId` (GuidId, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `groupType` (AnalyticalLoadGroupType)
- `relation` (AnalyticalLoadGroupRelation)
- `loadType` (string): The load type of the group as free text.

### AnalyticalLoadCase

object: A structural analysis load case.
- `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `description` (string)
- `actionType` (AnalyticalLoadCaseActionType)
- `loadGroupId` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the load group the load case belongs to.
- `loadType` (AnalyticalLoadCaseLoadType)
- `duration` (AnalyticalLoadCaseDuration): Left out when it is not set.

### AnalyticalLoadCombination

object: A structural analysis load combination.
- `loadCombinationId` (GuidId, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `description` (string)
- `category` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationCategory)
- `nationalStandard` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationNationalStandard): Left out when it is not set.
- `type` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationType): Left out when it is not set. Archicad 27 and newer.
- `loadFactors` (array of AnalyticalLoadFactor, required): The load cases of the combination with their factors.

### AnalyticalNode

object: A node of the Structural Analytical Model.
- `nodeId` (integer, required): The identifier of the node.
- `coord` (Coordinate3D, required)

### AnalyticalCurve

object: A curve of the Structural Analytical Model.
- `type` (string ("Line", "Arc", "Spline", "Bezier", "Ellipse")): The type of the curve. Bezier exists from Archicad 26.
- `begNode` (AnalyticalNode, required)
- `endNode` (AnalyticalNode, required)
- `midCoords` (array of Coordinate3D, required): The points between the start and the end of the curve.

### AnalyticalCrossSection

object: The cross section of a curve member. The profile image of Archicad 26 and newer is not returned.
- `crossSectionType` (string ("Rectangle", "Circle", "Attribute", "Custom"))
- `width` (number)
- `height` (number)
- `veneerThickness` (number)
- `profileAttrIndex` (integer): The attribute index of the profile.
- `materialAttrIndices` (array of integer): The attribute indices of the materials of the cross section.
- `profileParameters` (array of object): The parameters of the profile.
  - `parameterId` (GuidId, required)
  - `value` (number, required)
- `alignment` (string ("TopLeft", "Top", "TopRight", "Left", "Center", "Right", "BottomLeft", "Bottom", "BottomRight", "None")): The alignment of the cross section. Archicad 26 and newer.

### AnalyticalCurveMember

object: A curve member (beam, column) of the Structural Analytical Model.
- `analyticalMemberType` (AnalyticalMemberType)
- `elemGuid` (GuidId)
- `crossSection` (AnalyticalCrossSection)
- `curve` (AnalyticalCurve)
- `internalNodes` (array of AnalyticalNode)
- `rotationAngle` (number)
- `ey` (number)
- `eyVector` (Coordinate3D)
- `ez` (number)
- `ezVector` (Coordinate3D)
- `layerAttrIndex` (integer): The attribute index of the layer.
- `FEMType` (string ("Standard", "AxialForceOnly", "CompressionOnly", "TensionOnly"))
- `varyingSegmentList` (array of object): The segments of a member with varying cross section. Archicad 26 and newer.
  - `begProfile` (AnalyticalCrossSection, required)
  - `endProfile` (AnalyticalCrossSection): Only for a tapered segment.
  - `span` (number, required)

### AnalyticalSurfaceMember

object: A surface member (wall, slab, roof) or a segment of one of the Structural Analytical Model.
- `analyticalMemberType` (AnalyticalMemberType)
- `elemGuid` (GuidId)
- `surface` (object)
  - `surfaceType` (string ("Plane", "Cylinder"))
  - `planeSurface` (object)
  - `cylinderSurface` (object)
- `contour` (array of AnalyticalCurve): The curves of the outer contour.
- `holeContours` (array of object): The contours of the holes.
  - `contour` (array of AnalyticalCurve, required)
- `internalNodes` (array of AnalyticalNode)
- `thickness` (number)
- `lcsXVector` (Coordinate3D): The X axis of the local coordinate system. Archicad 26 and newer.
- `ez` (number)
- `ezVector` (Coordinate3D)
- `materialAttrIndex` (integer): The attribute index of the material.
- `layerAttrIndex` (integer): The attribute index of the layer.
- `FEMType` (string ("Plate", "Wall", "Shell"))
- `groupId` (GuidId)

### AnalyticalMemberConnections

array of GuidId: The identifiers of the connections of the analytical member.

### AnalyticalInternalMemberPartId

object: Identifies a part of an analytical member by its contour, edge or vertex and edge fragment.
- `contourIdx` (integer)
- `edgeOrVertexIdx` (integer)
- `edgeFragmentIndex` (integer)

### AnalyticalExportMappingTable

object
- `items` (array of object, required)
  - `partId` (AnalyticalInternalMemberPartId, required)
  - `elemPartIds` (array of object, required)

### AnalyticalExportIdMapping

object: Maps the edges and vertices of a surface member to the parts of the exported members. Archicad 26 and newer.
- `edges` (AnalyticalExportMappingTable, required)
- `vertices` (AnalyticalExportMappingTable, required)

### AnalyticalMemberPartRef

object: A reference to a part (vertex, edge or surface) of an analytical member. partId, customVertexData and ratioEdgeData are zero when left out.
- `elemGuid` (GuidId, required): The element of the analytical member.
- `partRefType` (string ("BegVertex", "EndVertex", "CustomVertex", "Edge", "RatioEdge", "Surface", "CustomSurface", "CustomEdge"), required)
- `partId` (AnalyticalInternalMemberPartId)
- `customVertexData` (object): The point of a CustomVertex.
  - `customVertexCoord` (Coordinate3D)
- `ratioEdgeData` (object): The part of the edge of a RatioEdge.
  - `ratioStart` (number)
  - `ratioEnd` (number)

### AnalyticalRigidityType

string ("Free", "Rigid", "Custom", "RigidCompressionOnly", "RigidTensionOnly", "CustomCompressionOnly", "CustomTensionOnly"): The rigidity of a degree of freedom of a release.

### AnalyticalRelease

object: The release of an analytical member.
- `guid` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the release.
- `releaseDescriptions` (array of object, required): The releases of the member parts. Each needs all six rigidities; a stiffness left out is 0.
  - `ux` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessX` (number)
  - `uy` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessY` (number)
  - `uz` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessZ` (number)
  - `fix` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessFix` (number)
  - `fiy` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessFiy` (number)
  - `fiz` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessFiz` (number)
  - `amPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalCoordinateSystem

object: A local coordinate system, given by its X and Y axes.
- `xVector` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `yVector` (Coordinate3D, required)

### AnalyticalCoordSysDirection

string ("Global", "Local"): Whether the values are in the global or in the local coordinate system.

### AnalyticalSupport

object: An analytical support: its settings and the member part it supports. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0.
- `supportSettings` (object, required)
  - `supportType` (string ("SimplePoint", "SingleLine", "Surface"), required)
  - `supportValues` (object, required): The rigidity and the value of the three translations and the three rotations.
  - `coordinateSystem` (AnalyticalCoordSysDirection, required)
- `supportedMemberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalSupportGeometry

object: The geometry of an analytical support in a Structural Analytical Model.
- `coordinates` (array of Coordinate3D, required)
- `translationStiffnessVector` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `rotationStiffnessVector` (Coordinate3D, required)

### AnalyticalLink

object: An analytical link: its settings and the member parts it connects. The rigid and the spring settings are both required, whichever type the link has. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0 and a resistance left out is false.
- `linkSettings` (object, required)
  - `geometry` (string ("Link1D", "Link2D"), required)
  - `type` (string ("Rigid", "Spring"), required)
  - `rigidSettings` (object, required)
  - `springSettings` (object, required)
- `startElementPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)
- `endElementPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalLinkGeometry

object: The geometry of an analytical link in a Structural Analytical Model.
- `coordinates` (array of Coordinate3D, required)
- `translationStiffnessVector` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `rotationStiffnessVector` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `curves` (array of AnalyticalCurve, required)

### AnalyticalLoadForceType

string ("Force", "Moment"): Whether the load is a force or a moment.

### AnalyticalPointLoad

object: An analytical point load: its settings and the member part it loads.
- `loadSettings` (object, required)
  - `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required): The load case the load belongs to.
  - `loadForceType` (AnalyticalLoadForceType, required)
  - `coordinateSystemType` (AnalyticalCoordSysDirection, required)
  - `xValue` (number, required)

  - `zValue` (number, required)

### AnalyticalEdgeLoad

object: An analytical edge load: its settings and the member part it loads.
- `loadSettings` (object, required)
  - `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required): The load case the load belongs to.
  - `loadForceType` (AnalyticalLoadForceType, required)
  - `loadDistributionType` (string ("Uniform", "Trapezoid"), required): Whether the load is the same along the edge or changes from the start value to the end value.
  - `coordinateSystemType` (AnalyticalCoordSysDirection, required)
  - `startValue` (Coordinate3D, required)
  - `endValue` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `loadedMemberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalSurfaceLoad

object: An analytical surface load: its settings and the member part it loads.
- `loadSettings` (object, required)
  - `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required): The load case the load belongs to.
  - `coordinateSystemType` (AnalyticalCoordSysDirection, required)
  - `xValue` (number, required)
  - `yValue` (number, required)
  - `zValue` (number, required)
- `loadedMemberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalEdgeLoadCustomData

object: The curve of an analytical edge load. CreateAnalyticalLoads needs at least one curve.
- `curve` (array of AnalyticalCurve, required)

### AnalyticalSurfaceLoadCustomData

object: The contour of an analytical surface load. CreateAnalyticalLoads needs at least one curve.
- `contour` (array of AnalyticalCurve, required)

### AnalyticalImportMappingTable

object

### AnalyticalImportIdMapping

object: Maps the edges and vertices of the given surface member to the parts of the new element. Archicad 26 and newer.

- `vertices` (AnalyticalImportMappingTable, required)
